tasks.title: Mapper contract + PoC entity/document shapes (Phase 2)

tasks.title: Generic Repository port + contract test, fake then real adapter (Phase 3)
tasks.description: back/src/shared/application/ports/Repository.ts generic port. _example gets a real Mongoose adapter (mongodb-memory-server) and an in-memory fake adapter, both proven interchangeable via ONE parametrized contract test.
tasks.notes: PR2 -- branch off qa AFTER PR1 (HEX-01/02) confirmed merged, per sequential (not stacked) delivery to avoid the auto-delete-branch-on-merge gotcha from Fase 0.

tasks.title: PoC use case (Phase 4)

tasks.title: Composition root (Phase 5)
tasks.description: back/src/composition-root.ts -- createCompositionRoot(options?) factory, real Mongoose adapter by default, any port overridable via CompositionOptions. Wiring test proving the whole chain (port -> use case -> adapter -> composition root) end-to-end. Does NOT touch start-test-app.ts (deferred to category migration).
